name: Integrate Brain Map with Core Pipeline
description: Wire Brain Map™ mastery engine into the canonical pipeline, ensuring every interaction triggers Bayesian posterior updates and struggle detection flows through to the decision engine.

subtasks.name: Wire Brain Map into Feature Engineering
subtasks.description: Modify src/core/features/implementation.ts to call updateMasteryFull() from brain-map.ts on every interaction event. The mastery update result (posteriorAlpha, posteriorBeta, CI, trajectorySlope, struggleFlags) must be included in the feature vector.

subtasks.name: Build forgetting curve module
subtasks.description: Create src/core/knowledge/forgetting-curve.ts implementing R(t) = e^(-t/S) with S-parameter learning. Create src/core/knowledge/spaced-repetition.ts for review interval scheduling.

subtasks.name: Wire struggle detection to intervention
subtasks.description: Connect struggleFlags from Brain Map updates to src/core/intervention/implementation.ts, triggering early alerts when declining mastery chains or widening CI are detected.
dependsOn: Wire Brain Map into Feature Engineering

subtasks.name: Update pipeline orchestrator
subtasks.description: Modify src/lib/pipeline.ts to include Brain Map mastery updates in the pipeline flow between Observe and Model stages.
dependsOn: Wire Brain Map into Feature Engineering

subtasks.name: Generate Brain Map integration tests
subtasks.description: Create tests/unit/core/brain-map.test.ts and tests/integration/brain-map-pipeline.test.ts verifying Bayesian invariants and end-to-end mastery flow.
